description: This is a Java source file defining a Spring MVC Controller named ConfigurationController, which manages configuration-related endpoints for an admin interface of a sales management application. The controller handles displaying and saving merchant configurations, including account settings and email configurations.

classes.name: ConfigurationController
classes.description: Spring MVC controller handling configurations for merchant accounts and email settings, providing methods to display and save configurations, and manage menu states.

methods.name: displayAccountsConfguration
methods.description: Handles GET requests to display account-related configurations such as Facebook page URL, Google Analytics URL, and Twitter handle for a merchant store.

methods.name: saveConfigurations
methods.description: Handles POST requests to save or update merchant account configurations.

methods.name: displayEmailSettings
methods.description: Handles GET requests to display email configuration settings for the store.

methods.name: saveEmailSettings
methods.description: Handles POST requests to save email configuration settings.

methods.name: setConfigurationMenu
methods.description: Utility method to set active menu items for the configuration section.

methods.name: setEmailConfigurationMenu
methods.description: Utility method to set active menu items specifically for email configuration section.
